description: Use when deploying permission sets, permission set groups, or profiles and encountering cross-reference errors, silent permission loss, or ordering failures. Triggers: 'permission set deployment fails', 'cross-reference id error during deploy', 'permissions disappear after deployment', 'permission set group deployment error'. NOT for permission set design or architecture decisions (use permission-set-architecture), NOT for creating permission sets from scratch (use admin/permission-set-architecture).
inputs: List of permission sets and permission set groups being deployed
Target org environment (sandbox, production, scratch org)
Deployment tool (sf CLI, change sets, Metadata API direct)
Any cross-reference error messages from the failed deployment
name: permission-set-deployment-ordering
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — PermissionSet metadata type — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_intro.htm — supports the include-all-metadata rule from API 40.0 (api_meta 264 L97416-97418), PSG fields and versions (L98009, L98039-98043) and ConnectedApp `permissionSetName` (L37225-37226).

Metadata API Developer Guide — Deploy Components in the Correct Order — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_deploy_order.htm — the one-at-a-time ordering rule is api_meta 264 L4246-4249; the page's own text is not in the corpus.
Salesforce CLI Reference — sf project deploy start — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.sfdx_cli_reference.meta/sfdx_cli_reference/cli_reference.htm
Salesforce Help — Permission Set Group — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.perm_sets_groups.htm — Help-only, UNVERIFIED (2026-10-20): not fetchable and not in the corpus.
outputs: Ordered deployment sequence to avoid cross-reference errors
Permission set validation checklist before deployment
Guidance on handling ConnectedApp permission conflicts
